newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Elderly Dutch women find novel parking spot - paper.
newsitem.headline: Elderly Dutch women find novel parking spot - paper.

text.p: Two elderly women suffered only minor injuries when their car shot through the third-floor wall of an Amsterdam multi-storey carpark and landed roof down on an adjacent shed, the daily De Telegraaf newspaper said on Tuesday.

The driver and passenger, both in their mid-80s, were descending from the fourth floor when the driver failed to make a turn, ramped the car over a concrete kerb and sent it crashing through the garage's metal and glass wall. The hatchback landed the equivalent of one floor lower on the shed, the paper said.
"The vehicle landed precisely on a roof beam. That was without doubt the ladies' salvation," a rescue worker was quoted as saying.
